# olivares_notification_route (Resource)

A notification route in the Olivares AI control plane (notify module): the rule that fans matching events out to a destination. Matchers are AND-combined; an empty matcher matches all. Authoring requires notify:route:write.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fan critical findings out to the on-call destination, deduped within 5 minutes.
resource "olivares_notification_route" "crit_to_pager" {
  name         = "crit-to-pager"
  destination  = "pagerduty-oncall"
  match_types  = ["finding"]
  min_severity = "critical"

  dedup_window_seconds = 300
  priority             = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination reference the matching events are delivered to (a configured channel/webhook id).
- `name` (String) Human-readable route name. Immutable (the engine never renames a route; changing it replaces the resource).

### Optional

- `dedup_window_seconds` (Number) Suppress duplicate notifications within this many seconds (0 = no dedup).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is active. Defaults to true.
- `match_kinds` (List of String) Event kinds to match. Empty matches all.
- `match_sources` (List of String) Event sources to match. Empty matches all.
- `match_subject_kinds` (List of String) Subject kinds to match. Empty matches all.
- `match_types` (List of String) Event types to match (e.g. "finding", "alert"). Empty matches all.
- `min_severity` (String) Minimum severity to forward: empty, or one of info, low, medium, high, critical. Empty forwards every severity.
- `priority` (Number) Route priority for ordering/selection (higher wins). Defaults to 0.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.
- `throttle_window_seconds` (Number) Rate-limit notifications to at most one per this many seconds (0 = no throttle).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned route ID.
- `owner_actor` (String) Actor that authored the route, recorded by the engine.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import olivares_notification_route.crit_to_pager rt_01HX...
```
